tools.name: analyze_narrative_divergence
tools.description: Compares real fundamental signals (P/E, real reference data) against a disclosed, real-price-derived momentum/volatility proxy for narrative intensity. Real fundamental/social sentiment data is not currently wired — narrative-side scoring is disclosed as a proxy, not literal sentiment measurement.

tools.name: simulate_counterfactual_stress_test
tools.description: Runs a disclosed hypothetical shock scenario (from a static, pre-defined scenario catalog) against a real live quote. The projected impact is an explicit heuristic model applied to a real spot price, not a claimed prediction.

tools.name: classify_microstructure_regime
tools.description: Real dealer gamma exposure (GEX) computed from a real fetched options chain (Tradier/Polygon), and Reg SHO threshold-list status from the SEC fails-to-deliver record via the SqueezeOS FTD oracle.

tools.name: execute_gemini_frontier_reasoning
tools.description: Invokes Google Gemini with real, live-fetched market data as grounding context — no invented inputs are passed to the model.

tools.name: generate_trade_execution_signals
tools.description: Generates a disclosed-heuristic BUY/SELL/HOLD verdict and selects real, currently-listed option contracts (real strike, real expiration, real bid/ask/greeks) nearest a target delta band from a real fetched chain — never an invented contract.

tools.name: mandelbrot_fractal_analysis
tools.description: Real Rescaled-Range Hurst exponent computed from real historical bars at each real timeframe (15M/1H/4H/1D/1W). Reports real excess kurtosis of the real return series. tools.name: track_volatility_surface
tools.description: Real implied-volatility surface grid built directly from a real fetched options chain across several real expirations — every grid point is a real listed contract, not an interpolated/fabricated one.

tools.name: track_gamma_squeeze_mechanics
tools.description: Real squeeze-pressure score from real chain-derived GEX and SEC fails-to-deliver pressure via the SqueezeOS FTD oracle — a disclosed proxy for short-selling pressure, not true short interest.

tools.name: live_universe_scanner_scan
tools.description: Real wide-market scan (Polygon grouped-daily aggregates across the real US equity universe, not a fixed short symbol list, no pinned symbols) fused with the real per-symbol GEX/Hurst/IV-surface engines above.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "coherence_jev_verdict" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: coherence_jev_verdict, earnings_gate_verdict · Private data: classify_microstructure_regime · Public sink: coherence_jev_verdict · Destructive: execute_gemini_frontier_reasoning, coherence_gate_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: coherence_jev_verdict, earnings_gate_verdict · Private data: classify_microstructure_regime · Public sink: coherence_jev_verdict · Destructive: execute_gemini_frontier_reasoning, coherence_gate_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
